nodes.label: SqliteAuthService
nodes.meaning: Coordinates one clock read, one transaction, trusted-input resolution, authorization-state resolution, kernel evaluation, and commit.

nodes.label: Trusted boundary
nodes.meaning: Validates trusted identities and constructs server-owned authorization command fields.

nodes.label: SQLite trusted-input provider
nodes.meaning: Reads authentication evidence and route binding from SQLite transaction state.

nodes.label: SQLite authorization provider
nodes.meaning: Reads revision-joined roles, grants, and trusted scope evidence.

nodes.label: Exact-permission kernel
nodes.meaning: Evaluates the exact role, grant, scope, and currentness predicates.

nodes.label: Auth integration tests
nodes.meaning: Current direct behavior examples; not EVF provider observations.

nodes.label: Auth EVF executable profile
nodes.meaning: All S0-S12 stages and 24 executable obligations with a deliberately non-passing raw Cargo provider route.

nodes.label: Provisional Cargo route
nodes.meaning: Exact structural runtime selection; blocked because Cargo stdout is not EVF provider JSON.

nodes.label: Auth theorem route
nodes.meaning: Exact Lean route selection; not evaluable until an Auth-specific theorem and Rust projection exist.
